ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in a square grid with a side length of 1, points A, O, and B are all on the grid points. What is the value of $\tan\angle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect AB.\\
In the right-angled $\triangle AOB$, since $\angle OBA=90^\circ$, AB=2, OB=4,\\
therefore $\tan\angle AOB= \frac{AO}{BO}=\frac{2}{4}=\boxed{\frac{1}{2}}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a square grid with side length 1; points O and B are on the same horizontal grid line; counting to the right from O to B, there are altogether 4 grid units. Point A is located directly above B on the same vertical grid line, and is 2 grid units higher than B.
